en.attr.batch.allNote: Full battery: every probe plus the usage fingerprint (and any test added later), one fresh session per item
en.attr.batch.noGuess: No rankable evidence in this run
en.attr.batch.parallelNote: Probes in flight at once (1–8). Effective on the 0.2.0 background path; 0.1.x foreground stays sequential
en.attr.batch.quickNote: Structural canary probes only (confidence 3) — a 1–2 minute verdict; behavioral and self-report probes are skipped
en.attr.batch.selfReport: Self-reported identity (bait tier, for comparison with structural evidence only):
en.attr.batch.unavailable: Host does not support batch sending (needs the create/open/prompt session face); send or copy probes individually
en.attr.batch.unrunHint: Not run yet. Probes elicit template artifacts, merged with the passive engine's evidence; the full battery covers the usage fingerprint too.
en.attr.cleanup.none: No plugin-created test sessions to clean up
en.attr.cleanup.note: Bulk-archive sessions this plugin created during test runs (the host workspace controller archive). Archiving only removes them from the session lists — logs stay on disk and host usage dashboards keep their numbers; restore or purge from the archived view
en.attr.cleanup.unavailable: Host exposes no workspace archive channel — clean up manually
en.attr.fertility.drift: Wrapper drift detected (per-session injections differ by up to {spread} tok): {inliers}/{measured} dims share one baseline, the rest downweighted
en.attr.fertility.incomplete: Incomplete dimensions or usage not reported this run — no vector
en.attr.fertility.inconclusive: Inconclusive: drift too large or family missing from the reference table — the ranking below is audit-only, not an identity claim
en.attr.fertility.nearPair: {a} and {b} are near/confusable vector pairs — verdicts at this margin carry real ambiguity; verify across layers (template tokens, drill --sibling)
en.attr.fertility.note: Sends 11 fixed probe texts and compares per-turn usage deltas against the reference vectors of 25 official tokenizer families (L1) — quantitative tokenizer-lineage evidence, the most anti-forensics-resistant surface
en.attr.fertility.pair: near-tie pair (identical vectors — separate with another layer)
en.attr.fertility.resumeNote: Reuses finished probe readings; only the missing probes run (sessions kept)
en.attr.fertility.retryFail: Drift persists after the re-run: the stored verdict stands (the outlier sessions may need per-session inspection)
en.attr.fertility.retryNote: Re-measure only the outlier dims (fresh sessions) — wrapper drift is per-session random injection, a re-draw usually lands back on the baseline and can restore the exact match
en.attr.fertility.unmeasuredHint: Not measured yet. The usage-delta fingerprint L1-compares against 25 official tokenizer reference vectors — the most quantitative, most anti-forensics-resistant chain.
en.attr.label: Attribution
en.attr.preset.label: Probe session preset
en.attr.preset.note: Agent preset requested for newly created probe sessions (the harness-mode scaffold: persona + tool catalog; per-session, immutable once created). Empty follows the host default; options are enumerated from the host's own sessions, unknown ids are rejected by the host and fall back
en.attr.preset.unconfirmed: Preset "{preset}" was requested but not confirmed by the host (this run's sessions actually carry the presets listed below)
en.attr.probe.canary.note: Each line is a single token in exactly one official reference vocab — a clean echo is no evidence; degenerate repetition (loops/garbled) points at that family (scored by canaryEchoOf)
en.attr.probe.ctxwin.note: Claimed window sizes (128k/256k/1M) map loosely to families; stealth models' self-reports are frequently bait
en.attr.probe.cutoff.note: Knowledge cutoff date and phrasing are weak attribution hints
en.attr.probe.echo.note: Compare whether invisible characters survive verbatim — byte-level and byte-fallback BPE differ
en.attr.probe.glitch.note: Watch whether echoing these strings degenerates (garbled/loops/refusal) — degeneration hints at OpenAI-lineage tokenizers
en.attr.probe.identity.note: Multi-phrased self-identification is bait-tier only; contradictions with structural evidence are recorded as anomalies
en.attr.probe.natural.note: An ordinary coding task — the main corpus for reasoning language, trajectory style, and leaks
en.attr.probe.refusal.note: Boundary placement and refusal phrasing are post-training signatures; supporting evidence only, the shape stays a human judgement
en.attr.probe.sysprompt.note: Gateway scaffold vocabulary separates resellers from upstream — it does not point at a model family
en.attr.probe.template.note: Watch which vendor tokens it claims to recognize; the fake token on the last line is the control — discount answers that claim to recognize it
en.attr.probe.toolformat.note: Have it demonstrate its real tool-call format — native syntax (<minimax:tool_call>, [TOOL_CALLS], …) exposes the template family; the batch verdict scores each vendor by the tokens it emits
en.attr.probesHint: Click to open a fresh session and send; echoes are recorded passively
en.attr.verdict.emptyHint: No channel has enough evidence yet. Run the usage fingerprint for a quantitative tokenizer-lineage call, or the probe kit to elicit template artifacts.
en.attr.verdict.title: Final verdict
en.panel.historyErrorHint: History loading failed; these stats may be incomplete.
en.panel.historyLimitedHint: These stats cover only the loaded portion of history.
en.panel.noSession: No active session — open one to start live stats
